payload.detail: SSC congbothongtin.ssc.gov.vn returns persistent domain-wide HTTP 503 (confirmed live, non-transient over 9+ min, all paths). VPS-side systemd services (vn-bctc-fetch, vn-bctc-enrich.timer/.service, vn-vps-proxy) all healthy/active, zero errors. HNX/UPCOM discovery paths on same VPS/run currently functional. Not anti-bot, not VPS network, not dead timer. Blocks SSC-CURL discovery for 30/33 (91%) HOSE-listed watchlist tickers right at Q2/2026 earnings SLA window open (July 1-15, 24h threshold).
payload.recommended_action: Implement previously-flagged-but-unshipped SSC 503 retry/backoff (1 retry, 60s backoff) in discover-bctc-urls-browser.py _ssc_curl_search() step1 GET, per residual risk #1 in docs/vps-sources/bctc-pipeline-stale-5d/recon.md (2026-06-16, never implemented). Monitor SSC portal for recovery — external outage, no scraper/code fix can restore it directly.
